Cleaner_Desc_EdgeCache: Temporary files, GPU cache, and shader cache in Microsoft Edge
Cleaner_Desc_EdgeHistory: Visited links, download history, and top sites in Microsoft Edge
Cleaner_Warn_EdgeHistory: Deletes your browsing and download history in Microsoft Edge.
Cleaner_Desc_EdgeCookies: Active website cookies and login sessions in Microsoft Edge
Cleaner_Warn_EdgeCookies: Clearing cookies will sign you out of websites in Microsoft Edge.
Cleaner_Desc_EdgeFormData: Saved autofill form entries and search suggestions in Microsoft Edge
Cleaner_Desc_EdgeSessions: Previously open tabs and session recovery in Microsoft Edge
Cleaner_Warn_EdgeSessions: Closes and forgets currently open tabs in Microsoft Edge.
Cleaner_Desc_EdgeVacuum: Defragments and compacts Microsoft Edge SQLite database files without losing data
Cleaner_Desc_ChromeCache: Web cache, code cache, GPUCache, and shaders in Google Chrome
Cleaner_Desc_ChromeHistory: Visited links, download history, and top sites in Google Chrome
Cleaner_Warn_ChromeHistory: Deletes your browsing and download history in Google Chrome.
Cleaner_Desc_ChromeCookies: Active website cookies and login sessions in Google Chrome
Cleaner_Warn_ChromeCookies: Clearing cookies will sign you out of websites in Google Chrome.
Cleaner_Desc_ChromeFormData: Saved autofill form entries and search suggestions in Google Chrome
Cleaner_Desc_ChromeSiteData: HTML5 LocalStorage, IndexedDB, and offline web app caches in Google Chrome
Cleaner_Warn_ChromeSiteData: Clears offline web app storage and site settings in Google Chrome.
Cleaner_Desc_ChromeAiModels: Downloaded on-device AI models (optimization_guide) in Google Chrome
Cleaner_Desc_ChromeVacuum: Defragments and compacts Google Chrome SQLite database files without losing data
Cleaner_Desc_ChromeCrash: Diagnostic crash reports and telemetry queues in Google Chrome
Cleaner_Desc_UserTemp: Temporary files and application caches in %TEMP% and %LOCALAPPDATA%\Temp
Cleaner_Desc_SystemTemp: System-wide temporary files and installer leftovers in C:\Windows\Temp
Cleaner_Desc_WinUpdate: Downloaded update packages in SoftwareDistribution\Download and Delivery Optimization cache
Cleaner_Desc_Shellbags: Clears BagMRU, Bags, and Explorer search box history (WordWheelQuery)
Cleaner_Warn_Shellbags: Resets custom folder view layouts and Explorer search history.
Cleaner_Desc_RunMru: Clears Win+R Run command history in HKCU\...\Explorer\RunMRU
Cleaner_Warn_RecentDocs: Clears your Recent Files list and taskbar Jump List pinned/recent history.
Cleaner_Desc_Clipboard: Clears all currently copied text, images, and data from memory clipboard
Cleaner_Desc_DnsCache: Flushes the local DNS cache via DnsFlushResolverCache / ipconfig /flushdns
Cleaner_Desc_SystemLogs: Clears Windows Event Logs (Application, System, Setup), CBS logs, Panther, and WER reports
Cleaner_Warn_SystemLogs: Clears diagnostic event logs that may be needed for troubleshooting recent errors.
Cleaner_Desc_MemoryDumps: Kernel/Complete crash dumps (MEMORY.DMP), Minidumps, and LiveKernelReports
Cleaner_Desc_MuiCache: Clears cached application display names in HKCU\...\Shell\MuiCache
Cleaner_Desc_RecycleBin: Permanently empties Recycle Bins across all drives via SHEmptyRecycleBin
Cleaner_Warn_RecycleBin: Permanently deletes all items currently in the Recycle Bin.
Cleaner_Desc_ChromCache: Clears Cache, Cache_Data, Code Cache, GPUCache, Service Worker & ShaderCache across all profiles
Cleaner_Desc_ChromCrash: Deletes browser crash dumps and telemetry reports in Crashpad\reports
Cleaner_Desc_ChromCookies: Deletes SQLite Cookies databases across all Chrome and Edge profiles
Cleaner_Warn_ChromCookies: Signs you out of websites in Google Chrome and Microsoft Edge.
Cleaner_Desc_ChromHistory: Deletes History, History-journal, Visited Links, and Top Sites across all profiles
Cleaner_Warn_ChromHistory: Permanently deletes browsing and download history in Chrome and Edge.
Cleaner_Desc_ChromFormData: Clears saved autofill form entries in Web Data across all profiles
Cleaner_Warn_ChromFormData: Deletes saved autofill addresses and form text entries (does not delete saved passwords).
Cleaner_Item_ChromAiModels: Local AI Models (Gemini Nano / On-Device AI)
Cleaner_Desc_ChromAiModels: Removes large downloaded on-device AI models (OptGuideOnDeviceModel / optimization_guide_model_store)
Cleaner_Warn_ChromAiModels: Deletes multi-gigabyte local browser AI weights; browser may re-download them if on-device AI is used.
Cleaner_Desc_ChromSiteData: Deletes Local Storage, IndexedDB, Session Storage, and WebStorage across all profiles
Cleaner_Warn_ChromSiteData: Clears offline web app data and site settings stored in LocalStorage/IndexedDB.
Cleaner_Desc_ChromSessions: Deletes Sessions folder, Current Session, and Current Tabs in Chrome and Edge
Cleaner_Warn_ChromSessions: Closes and forgets currently saved open tabs/sessions from your last browser window.
Cleaner_Desc_ChromVacuum: Executes SQLite 'VACUUM;' on History, Web Data, Favicons, Top Sites & Cookies without losing data
Cleaner_Desc_DefenderTemp: Cleans C:\ProgramData\Microsoft\Windows Defender\Scans\History and Support diagnostic files
Cleaner_Desc_DefenderQuarantine: Permanently deletes quarantined items in C:\ProgramData\Microsoft\Windows Defender\Quarantine
Cleaner_Warn_DefenderQuarantine: Quarantined files cannot be restored once deleted. Requires Administrator/SYSTEM privileges.
Cleaner_Desc_DeepOrphans: Deep scans for .DS_Store, Thumbs.db, and Vim swap/temp files (*.swp, *.swo, *.tmp) within the selected root folder
Cleaner_Desc_DeepNode: Finds and removes heavy node_modules and .angular build folders inside the Deep Scan root path
Cleaner_Desc_DeepPython: Finds and removes __pycache__ and Python virtual environments (venv / .venv) in the Deep Scan root path
Cleaner_Item_DeepOsJunk: OS Metadata & Vim Swap Files (.DS_Store, Thumbs.db, *.swp)
Cleaner_Desc_DeepOsJunk: Recursively finds .DS_Store, Thumbs.db, and Vim swap files (*.swp, *.swo) under the Deep Scan root
Cleaner_Desc_DeepNodeVenv: Recursively finds heavy node_modules, venv, and .venv directories under the Deep Scan root
Cleaner_Warn_DeepNodeVenv: Deletes node_modules and Python venv folders! You will need to run 'npm install' or recreate venvs.
Cleaner_Desc_ErrorReports: Archived crash reports, mini-dumps, and error reporting queues
Cleaner_Desc_DeliveryOpt: Peer-to-peer Windows Update delivery cache files
